improvements: 插件现已迁移至内置沙箱环境运行，提升了运行时的安全隔离度与整体稳定性。
The plugin now runs within the built-in sandbox environment to deliver enhanced security isolation and runtime stability.

releases.body:
## English

### Improvements

- The plugin now runs within the built-in sandbox environment to deliver enhanced security isolation and runtime stability.

---

## 中文

### 改进

- 插件现已迁移至内置沙箱环境运行，提升了运行时的安全隔离度与整体稳定性。

fixes: 恢复了对旧版本宿主应用的存储与界面权限支持，确保各项界面组件与本地数据在较早版本的客户端中均能正常使用。
The plugin now restores legacy storage and interface permissions, ensuring that all UI elements and saved data function reliably on older versions of the host application.

releases.body:
## English

### Fixes

- The plugin now restores legacy storage and interface permissions, ensuring that all UI elements and saved data function reliably on older versions of the host application.

---

## 中文

### 修复

- 恢复了对旧版本宿主应用的存储与界面权限支持，确保各项界面组件与本地数据在较早版本的客户端中均能正常使用。

improvements: 右上角的通知横幅现已改为显示插件默认图标。
other: 插件不再申请存储与界面的豁免权限，缩减了运行所需的权限范围。

improvements: Notification banners in the top-right corner now display the default plugin icon.
other: The plugin no longer requests exempt storage and user interface permissions, reducing the required access scope.

releases.body:
## English

### Improvements

- Notification banners in the top-right corner now display the default plugin icon.

### Other

- The plugin no longer requests exempt storage and user interface permissions, reducing the required access scope.

---

## 中文

### 改进

- 右上角的通知横幅现已改为显示插件默认图标。

### 其他

- 插件不再申请存储与界面的豁免权限，缩减了运行所需的权限范围。
